messages.text: My issue with the wrong power supply being shipped with my Nexus S1 still has not been addressed.
Handed to the team · Correct power supply has to ship on a new free order, which I can't create. Cust

Nicholas, I'm sorry. You told us about this on October 31, and nothing has been sent to you since. You shouldn't have had to bring it up again.

I've just passed it to the team as a packing error on Shop····. That means the correct power supply for your Nexus S1 should go to you on a new order at no cost, with nothing to send back. Someone will pick up your ticket and email you an answer.

Could you send a photo of the label on the power supply that came in the box? I'll add it to your case.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Thanks, Nicholas. That's a Mean Well LRS-200-12, rated 12V at 17A, and I've added it to your case on Shop····.

One safety point from the yellow sticker on it: this supply has a manual voltage switch on the side. On US mains it has to be set to 115V before you plug it in, because the wrong setting can destroy it.

The team is offline right now. They'll pick up your case tomorrow at 10am ET and email you about the correct power supply. Your photo and details are saved, so you won't need to send anything again.
You're welcome, Nicholas. Sorry again that you had to chase this. The team will email you about the right power supply once they pick up your case tomorrow.
Ok, are you able to update me on my B30?
Handed to the team · Ship date is today and the unit isn't in the warehouse. No newer date on file to

Nicholas, your B30 on Shop···· was set to ship today, November 15. The B30 hasn't reached our Tennessee warehouse yet, though, so it won't go out today. Your Power Kit is already there, set aside for it.

I won't guess a new date. I've asked the team for the current one. They pick this up tomorrow at 10am ET along with your power supply case, and the answer will come to your email.

You can follow the B30 batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
You're welcome, Nicholas. You'll get answers on the power supply and the B30 date by email. Sorry again for the wait on both.
